name: Macaron Raspberry
ingredients_raw: Meringues ingredients (72%): sugar 45%, almond flour 29%, egg albumen powder, sweetener: sorbitol syrup (E420, 28.8%/kg); soy proteins, rice starch, sunflower oil, vegetable fibre, preservative: potassium sorbate E202; emulsifier: sunflower lecithin E322; acidifier: citric acid E330; thickener: xanthan gum E415, guar gum E412; flavour: ethyl acetate E1130; potato starch, corn starch, food colours: carmoisine E122, blue brilliant E133, Cream filling ingredients (28%): base custard (sugar, white chocolate (sugar, whole milk powder), skimmed milk, vegetable fats (palm kernel, palm, sunflower), skimmed milk, emulsifier: soy lecithin, emulsifier: sunflower lecithin, artificial flavour), strawberry juice powder (maltodextrin, artificial flavour), strawberry juice, artificial raspberry flavour 0.4%, vegetable fats (palm kernel, palm), emulsifier: E471 plant origin, stabilizer: pectin, acidifier: citric acid, preservative: potassium sorbate, emulsifier: mono - and diacetyl tartaric esters of mono - and diglycerides of fatty acids E472e
